items.title: “I'm getting my pop back.”
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
“I'm getting my pop back.”

Paul George hasn’t felt this good physically since he was with the Clippers. The result? Producing a game-high 38 points yesterday.

That’s the most in a Celtics debut. He also became the 8th player in NBA history to combine that with at least 7 3s & 5 steals.

1/2
